items.label: STURDY FRAME DESIGN
items.value: Crafted from high-quality wood with a robust front-loading panel, magnetic closure, and deep molding for 3D artwork. Perfect for showcasing children's masterpieces, multi-layered crafts, or cherished photos with ease.

items.label: VERSATILE DISPLAY OPTIONS
items.value: Equipped with dual sawtooth hangers, allowing for both vertical and horizontal wall mounting. A removable white mat adds versatility, making it ideal for drawings, paintings, or even magazine clippings. Variety of sizes and packs available to suit your needs.

items.label: SHOWCASE CREATIVITY IN STYLE
items.value: Designed to elevate your child's artwork into gallery-worthy pieces. The sleek and polished finish effortlessly blends with home decor, creating a vibrant focal point in playrooms, bedrooms, or even office spaces.

items.label: EASY ACCESS AND SECURE STORAGE
items.value: Features a magnetic front panel door for quick artwork changes without hassle. Elastic straps securely hold photos or papers inside, ensuring their safety while keeping the art ready for display at any moment.

items.label: PROTECTIVE AND RELIABLE PACKAGING
items.value: Each frame is carefully packed with proprietary foam padding and corner braces for maximum protection during transit. Your frames will arrive intact and ready to turn your space into an artistic haven.
